newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLISH FUTURE FOR SAINT-ANDRE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLISH FUTURE FOR SAINT-ANDRE.

text.p: French international wing Philippe Saint-Andre is joining English club Gloucester from Montferrand, adding to the growing list of top overseas players in British domestic rugby.
The 30-year-old Saint-Andre, capped 64 times and his country's regular captain until injury forced him to miss the entire Five Nations season, has signed a two-year contract.
"Initially we decided not to go for big names, but most weeks we're playing against teams with at least eight international players," said Gloucester coach Richard Hill.
Former Springbok and Wallaby test captains Francois Pienaar and Michael Lynagh are already playing in English rugby with London side Saracens.
